source: Anthropic's Opus 5.5 prompting guide lists "an offer to carry on with something unless the user would prefer otherwise" as a habit to suppress; 1.93 per 10,000 words in Opus 5.5 replies, none in the baselines
notes: Fires only when the offer is the last sentence of the text. A question followed by a reason, such as `Do you want me to delete it? It has two unmerged commits.`, stays unflagged. A setup that asks before every test run can list `closing-offer` in `excludePacks`.

patterns.fix: cut the offer, or name the step that needs approval
patterns.show: `Want me to ...?` or `Do you want me to ...?` at the end of the text
